name: Castel Gandolfo (Italy)
description: Blue field charged with a white lozenge throughout bearing the crowned municipal arms of Castel Gandolfo (a tower on the lake beneath an angel) within branches, with the Olympic rings beneath.
history: The flag was granted by decree of the President of the Republic on 27 November 2009.

features.role: Castel Gandolfo arms — tower on the lake beneath an angel, crowned, within branches, with the Olympic rings
